idee_recherchee.texte: The holographic principle proposes that all the information contained in a volume of space can be encoded on its boundary surface, as if our three-dimensional universe were a projection from a two-dimensional surface.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: Solutions proposées au paradoxe de l'information et si l'information est détruite
resume: Proposed answers include information encoded in Hawking radiation, written on the black hole's surface like a hard drive, or stored in a higher dimensional realm if space-time is an illusion. If black holes truly destroy information, every moment of history could be erased and made as if it never existed.
texte: Some theorists think [music] that information is somehow encoded in the Hawking radiation that black holes emit. This is residual thermal energy named after the famous [music] first proponent of the information paradox, Stephen Hawking. Others suggest it's written on the black hole's surface particle interactions, like a deep space [music] hard drive. But, some think space-time itself might be an illusion, and information [music] exists in some higher dimensional realm that we can't access. But, what if none of these solutions work? What if black holes really do destroy information? Then, everything [music] that has ever happened, every human life, every thought, every moment could theoretically be permanently erased, and not just from existence, but from the possibility of ever having existed.
